summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of the unified-cart final polish for Taher Ali Enterprises. All 22 spec areas verified end-to-end: home hero + Aliabad Kotla address, retail catalog with Add-to-Cart→qty controls, wholesale catalog (106 rows) with new Add-to-Cart pattern + in-cart badge + row qty controls, absence of all old wholesale/bulk testids, unified cart drawer with grouped RETAIL/WHOLESALE sections, badge visibility rules, qty updates (including decrease-to-zero removal), cart persistence via tae_cart_v2, unified checkout modal with all 7 fields, required-field validation with role=alert messages, invalid-mobile validation, grouped order summary, delivery info box (Free within 3km / ₹50 outside), WhatsApp URL construction (wa.me/916305486808) with exact spec-compliant message format (greeting, *Customer Details*, *Order*, *Retail Products*, *Wholesale Products*, bulleted items, Total Items, Estimated Total, Aliabad Kotla delivery note, Please confirm, Thank you.), floating cart visibility rules (only on / and /products after scroll; hidden on /wholesale and /products/:id), PDP sticky bar + image notice, dark mode toggle + persistence, nav links (no Bulk Calculator). 58/58 automated assertions passed.

issues: Label reads 'Wholesale Cart' but cart is now unified (retail + wholesale). Consider renaming to 'View Cart' or 'Your Cart' to avoid confusing retail users.

action_items: (Minor / optional) Rename FloatingCartButton label 'Wholesale Cart' → 'View Cart' since the cart is now unified.

(Minor / optional) React console warning: `<span> cannot be a child of <option>` on Wholesale filter dropdown — inspect WholesaleProductsPage sort/filter <option> markup and remove nested <span> to eliminate hydration warning. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: ShopContext, CartDrawer, CheckoutModal are clean, DRY, and well-structured. WhatsApp message builder matches the spec exactly.
FloatingCartButton always mounts the DOM node but toggles visibility via opacity/pointer-events (acceptable). Consider fully conditional render on /wholesale and /products/:id to reduce DOM.
All required data-testids present and stable across pages.
seed_data_creation: None. Test used built-in mock products (p1, p2 retail; w19 + first two wholesale items).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only app, base URL https://wholesale-provisions-3.preview.emergentagent.com. localStorage key is tae_cart_v2. To intercept the WhatsApp URL for validation, override window.open in the page before clicking whatsapp-place-order-btn. Filter panel on /wholesale is collapsible via [data-testid='wholesale-filter-toggle'] — open it before clicking filter chips. Sort dropdown is a native <select> — use select_option, not click. All old wholesale/bulk testids are confirmed gone.
